name: @pipeworx/mcp-spacenews

tools.name: get_articles
tools.description: Fetch the latest spaceflight news articles sorted by publication date. Returns title, summary, URL, image, and source.

limit.description: Number of articles to return (default 10, max 100)

tools.name: search_articles
tools.description: Search spaceflight news articles by keyword. Returns matching articles with title, summary, URL, and publication date.

limit.description: Number of results to return (default 10, max 100)

tools.name: get_blogs
tools.description: Fetch the latest spaceflight blog posts sorted by publication date. Returns title, summary, URL, image, and source.

limit.description: Number of blog posts to return (default 10, max 100)

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-spacenews forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the spacenews pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
